title: Joinings in Markov categories
summary: Dynamical systems theory primarily concerns the study of different forms of invariance, such as invariant sets, densities, measures, and observables. Ergodic systems are a special class of dynamical systems which are measure theoretically irreducible. In spite of this specialized property they dominate most discussions on ergodic theory because of the ergodic decomposition theorem. The viewpoint that any dynamical system is a composite of multiple ergodic components enables us to partition the face space into the basins of the different measures.
